place.en: The Si · Before the stone door

setup.zh: 十月初一，泗水退潮，露出一道石门。几百个外门弟子挤在门前，手里都攥着地图。马小宝坐在一只描金小木匣后面：「公中，一人一块。」
setup.en: The first of the tenth month: the Si draws back and shows a stone door. Hundreds of outer disciples crowd before it, maps in hand. Ma Xiaobao sits behind a little gilded box. "Common fund. One each."

recap.zh: 十月初一，沉鼎秘境开了。{伴}把{伴·她}的地图借给你——利息，两块。
recap.en: On the first of the tenth month the hidden realm opened. {伴} lent you the map — interest, two stones.

zh: 石门前，几百个外门弟子攥着地图。
en: The first of the tenth month: the Si draws back.
Before the stone door, hundreds of disciples clutch their maps.

story.zh:
十月初一。

沉鼎秘境，开了。

秘境在泗水底下。每十年，泗水退一次潮，露出一道石门。石门后面，是一座不知道多少年前留下来的遗迹——沉鼎观的名字，就是从这里来的。外门弟子进去，各凭本事。捡到什么，归什么。

几百个外门弟子挤在石门前，手里都攥着地图——前人画的，一代一代传下来，画得密密麻麻。哪里有灵草，哪里有机关，哪里有前人留下的破法器，地图上都标着。

**{伴}**：（凑过来）你的地图呢？

**你**：没有。

**{伴}**：你不买？一张地图才一块灵石。

**你**：我的灵石，一块交了公中，一块交了公中，一块……

**{伴}**：交了公中。

**你**：交了公中。

{伴}看了你一会儿，把{伴·她}的地图塞给了你。

**{伴}**：借你。利息，两块。

**你**：……你到底借给多少人过？

**{伴}**：就你一个。（面无表情）所以利息高。

石门边上，马小宝又摆开了那只描金的小木匣。

**马小宝**：秘境门口，公中，一人一块。外门的规矩。
story.en:
Tenth month, first day.

The Chending hidden realm opens.

The hidden realm lies under the Si. Once every ten years the Si's tide goes out and a stone gate appears. Behind it is a ruin left from who knows how many years ago — it's where Chending Temple gets its name. Outer-court disciples go in on their own wits. Whatever you pick up is yours.

Hundreds of outer-court disciples crowd in front of the stone gate, every one clutching a map — drawn by those before, handed down generation to generation, packed dense with marks. Where the spirit herbs are, where the traps are, where old broken artifacts lie — it's all on the map.

**{伴}:** (sidling up) Where's your map?

**You:** Haven't got one.

**{伴}:** You're not buying one? A map's only one spirit stone.

**You:** My spirit stones: one went to the common fund, one went to the common fund, one…

**{伴}:** Went to the common fund.

**You:** Went to the common fund.

{伴} looks at you a moment, then shoves {伴·她} map at you.

**{伴}:** A loan. Interest: two.

**You:** …How many people have you lent to, exactly?

**{伴}:** Just you. (deadpan) That's why the interest is high.

By the stone gate, Ma Xiaobao has set out that little gilded wooden box again.

**Ma Xiaobao:** At the hidden realm's gate, common fund, one each. Outer-court rules.

exits.means: pays one stone to Ma Xiaobao's common fund

refuse.en: You have no spirit stones on you.

what.zh: 十月初一，秘境门口，公中：一块灵石。
what.en: The first of the tenth month, at the hidden realm's door, the common fund: one spirit stone.

story.zh:
你把一块灵石放进匣子里。

**马小宝**：懂事。

你往前走了十步，停下来，摸出小本子，舔了舔笔尖：**十月初一。公中。灵石一块。马小宝。**
story.en:
You put one spirit stone in the box.

**Ma Xiaobao:** Good sense.

You walk ten steps on, stop, take out your notebook and lick the brush tip: **Tenth month, first day. Common fund. One spirit stone. Ma Xiaobao.**

exits.means: refuses to pay the common fund

what.zh: 十月初一，秘境门口：你没交公中。他笑着说，秘境里死个把人，可不稀奇。
what.en: The first of the tenth month, at the hidden realm's door: you didn't pay the common fund. He smiled: people die in the hidden realm all the time.

story.zh:
你从匣子前面走了过去，像没看见。

**马小宝**：（在你身后，笑得很开心）{name}。秘境里死个把人，可不稀奇。

你没回头。你摸出小本子，舔了舔笔尖：**十月初一。公中。没交。马小宝笑了。**
story.en:
You walk past the box as if you don't see it.

**Ma Xiaobao:** (behind you, smiling very happily) {name}. People dying in a hidden realm — nobody's surprised.

You don't look back. You take out your notebook and lick the brush tip: **Tenth month, first day. Common fund. Didn't pay. Ma Xiaobao smiled.**
